✨ Open-Source-Face-Recognition-SDK | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling developers to integrate robust, privacy-preserving face recognition and analysis into their applications without data leaving the user's device.
✨ Key Features: • 100% On-Premise processing • High Accuracy • Real-Time Processing • Easy Integration (Python APIs) • Cross-Platform (Windows, Linux)
📖 Summary: This is a free, open-source Python SDK for face recognition and analysis, designed for on-premise deployment on Windows and Linux. It leverages deep learning for high-accuracy, real-time face detection, landmark extraction, and comparison, ensuring complete data privacy.
